text:
emily: quick follow-up from the pricing block — what's the intended UX when a trial hits quota mid-flow? do we block, show CTA, or allow a short grace?

raj: trials get a short grace window (configurable, default 5m) that returns 200 with header X-Quota-Status: soft_limit_exceeded for a limited time. after grace expires requests return 429/quota_exceeded. we don't auto-charge trials.

sofia: are embeddings and generation drawn from the same quota or separate? customer asked specifically.

raj: separate quota lines by default: tokens and embeddings. we do support pooled credits for promos but that's a special flag on the billing account.

emily: what about promo credits — do they ever auto-expand quota?

sofia: credits apply to invoice balance only. there is a manual ops flow to convert a credit to a temporary quota top-up for pilots; automated mapping is under consideration but needs controls.

emily: SDK teams requested a stable error schema we can rely on. can we standardize now?

raj: yes: 429 -> {"error":"quota_exceeded","quota_type":"tokens|embeddings","grace_remaining":int}. 429 for rate limiting -> {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":int}. 402 -> {"error":"insufficient_funds"}. we'll publish examples.

sofia: can we expose remaining quota to client apps? mobile wants to show "X tokens left".

raj: propose opt-in header X-Redwood-Remaining: tokens=12345;embeddings=80 and an authenticated /v1/usage endpoint for admin keys. header only returned for key owners and when enabled.

emily: webhooks? CS wants alerts for 80/95%.

ops-bot: system: created follow-ups -> #6123 docs:quota-errors, #6124 billing:webhook-org-usage, #6125 console:quota-header-optin

emily: thanks — can we make the docs include a tiny retry pattern for SDKs and a sample UI string for the mobile team?

raj: yes, adding to #6123. will include sample payloads and a recommended exponential backoff + user CTA when grace_remaining>0.

all-hands-bot: Reminder: recording + slides posted to #all-hands.
